1.prompt:
A chest-up photograph of <<<a0e68491-43ac-40c8-99d5-fec60596ac50>>>, a 23-year-old Chinese woman in Suzhou, seen almost straight on, her face turned no more than ten degrees off the lens.

Her build: narrow shoulders and a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how slight the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden or wheat-coloured), with visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, a slight oil sheen on the T-zone and unretouched skin detail.

Her black hair is straight and falls past her waist, loose and slightly disordered from sleep, pushed back off her face so both eyebrows and her whole jawline are clearly visible.

She wears an ivory silk robe worn open over a thin matching camisole, the silk creased from being slept in, the collar sitting unevenly on one side.

She sits at a dark elm dressing table in the bedroom of an old Suzhou courtyard house. On the table: an open tin of face cream with the lid beside it, three hairpins, a half-drunk cup of tea gone cold, a folded cotton towel, a comb with a few hairs in it, and her phone face-down. The lacquer on the table edge is worn pale where hands have rested for decades.

Cool early-morning daylight enters low and horizontal through a carved wooden lattice window at frame left. The pale lime-plaster wall opposite and the bare mirror glass on the dressing table bounce a soft neutral fill back onto the shadow side of her face. A small brass desk lamp still switched on behind her adds a second, much warmer tungsten source, so cool window light and warm lamplight sit in the same frame. The camera is metered for her face, so the window itself and the courtyard beyond it clip out to white and the carved lattice reads as a black silhouette against them. The lattice pattern throws soft-edged geometric shapes across the wall and across the edge of her shoulder.

Her expression is unguarded and still, lips closed and relaxed, eyes on the lens without performing for it.

The only person anywhere in this photograph is her — no one else in the room, no one in any doorway, no figure in any mirror or window reflection, no portrait or photograph of a person on any wall or screen. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Shot on a rear phone camera from about a metre away, crisp sharp focus on her face, fine detail in the silk weave, natural colour grading, slight autofocus softness on the objects at the back of the table.
1.note: 臉與 master 一致，胸型有讀出來，晨光＋檯燈雙色溫成立，桌面雜物生活感到位。可發布。

2.prompt:
A chest-up photograph of <<<a0e68491-43ac-40c8-99d5-fec60596ac50>>>, a 23-year-old Chinese woman in Suzhou, her body turned about forty degrees to her left and her head turned back toward the lens over her near shoulder.

Her build: narrow shoulders and a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how slight the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden or wheat-coloured), with visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, a slight oil sheen on the T-zone and unretouched skin detail.

Her black waist-length hair is gathered into a low loose bun at the nape with a wooden pin, several strands escaping at her temple and along her neck. Her forehead, both eyebrows and her jawline are fully visible.

She wears a plain ink-blue silk qipao with a low mandarin collar and no pattern, the fabric matte rather than shiny, fitted through the ribcage and waist. A cloth tape measure hangs over her shoulders.

She stands in her own qipao tailoring shop in a converted old house: bolts of silk stacked on a wall rack behind her in dull jade, oxblood and cream, a cutting table at the edge of frame with chalk marks on the wood, a pincushion, a paper pattern weighted down with a pair of scissors, and a rail of finished qipao on wooden hangers.

Overcast daylight comes through the glazed shopfront door at frame right, soft but clearly directional. A bolt of pale ivory silk propped beside her and the whitewashed wall bounce a warm off-white fill up into her jaw and neck. A low pendant bulb over the cutting table adds a warmer tungsten source deeper in the shop, so the daylight side of her face is cooler than the side facing the room. Exposure is set for her, so the street visible through the glass door blows out. The rail of hanging qipao at the frame edge partly blocks the door light and cuts a soft vertical shadow across the wall behind her.

She is mid-thought about the work in her hands, a small closed-lip smile just starting, eyes on the lens.

The only person anywhere in this photograph is her — no one else in the room, no one in any doorway, no figure in any mirror or window reflection, no portrait or photograph of a person on any wall or screen. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Shot on a rear phone camera at standing height, crisp sharp focus on her face and the silk texture, natural colour grading, faint JPEG compression at the high-contrast edge of the doorway.
2.note: 構圖與光線都成立、可發布，但臉疑似漂移——眼型比 master 圓大、下顎較飽滿、年齡感偏小。40 度側轉本身會改變外觀，需使用者判定是漂移還是角度。

3.prompt:
A waist-up front-facing selfie of <<<a0e68491-43ac-40c8-99d5-fec60596ac50>>>, a 23-year-old Chinese woman in Suzhou, her body angled about thirty-five degrees to her right, her face turned back to the camera which is held slightly above her eye level.

Her build: narrow shoulders and a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how slight the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Her waist is narrow, and the contrast between that small waist and the fuller chest is part of her shape. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden or wheat-coloured), with visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, a slight oil sheen on the T-zone and unretouched skin detail.

Her black straight hair falls past her waist, swept forward over her right shoulder and behind her left, both eyebrows and the whole line of her jaw uncovered.

She wears a deep oxblood silk camisole with thin straps and a fine bias-cut hem, with a soft charcoal cardigan slipping off one shoulder.

She is in the bedroom of the old house late in the evening. Behind her: a wooden bed with the quilt pushed back in a heap, a charging cable trailing off the nightstand onto the floor, an open book face-down, a glass of water half drunk, and a paper lampshade slightly crooked on its stand.

A single warm tungsten table lamp with a paper shade sits close and low at frame left and is the only light on her. The polished dark elm tabletop throws a dim warm underlight back up onto her chin and the pale bedding behind her returns a weak fill onto her shoulder. Cold blue dusk still shows through the courtyard window behind her, unlit, so a warm near side and a cold far side coexist. Exposure is set for her lamp-lit face and the rest of the room falls away into deep shadow. The edge of the paper lampshade cuts a soft horizontal shadow across the wall.

Her expression is quiet and a little tired, mouth closed, eyes level with the lens.

The only person anywhere in this photograph is her — no one else in the room, no one in any doorway, no figure in any mirror or window reflection, no portrait or photograph of a person on any wall or screen. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Front camera quality — slightly softer focus than a rear camera shot, mild natural grain, slightly lower dynamic range, gentle noise in the dark parts of the room, NOT ultra-crisp or overly HD.
3.note: 臉與 master 一致，自拍質感（較軟、有噪點）正確，暖檯燈 vs 窗外藍調雙色溫成立，胸腰讀得出來。可發布。

4.prompt:
A full-length photograph of <<<a0e68491-43ac-40c8-99d5-fec60596ac50>>>, a 23-year-old Chinese woman in Suzhou, photographed from head to feet with her whole body inside the frame, standing almost square to the camera and turned no more than fifteen degrees.

Her build: narrow shoulders and a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how slight the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Her waist is narrow, and the contrast between that small waist and the fuller chest is part of her shape. Her lower abdomen is flat and her hips are about as wide as her shoulders. Her legs are long and straight. She is 165cm and slight. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden or wheat-coloured), with visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, a slight oil sheen on the T-zone and unretouched skin detail.

Her black straight waist-length hair is half pinned up at the crown and half left loose down her back, both eyebrows and her jawline clearly visible.

She wears a pale celadon-green silk qipao with a short mandarin collar, a plain weave with no print, cut close through the bust, ribcage and waist and falling straight to mid-calf, with flat cloth shoes.

She stands on the stone walkway of a classical Suzhou garden very early in the morning: a still pond directly beside her with duckweed drifting on it, a whitewashed wall behind, a bare-branched plum tree, wet flagstones from overnight rain with a leaf stuck to one, and a moon-gate arch framing the far end of the walkway.

Flat overcast early-morning skylight comes from the whole sky above with no visible sun and no hard shadow edge anywhere. The still pond surface beside the walkway throws a faint cool silver light up under her chin and along the underside of her sleeves, and the whitewashed wall behind returns an even neutral fill. This is a genuinely low-contrast scene — nothing in it is bright enough to clip and nothing crushes to black; her skin sits only a little brighter than the pale stone. The moon-gate arch darkens the top corners of the frame.

She looks off past the camera toward the water, calm, lips closed, unposed.

The only person anywhere in this photograph is her — no one else in the room, no one in any doorway, no figure in any mirror or window reflection, no portrait or photograph of a person on any wall or screen. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Shot on a rear phone camera from about four metres away at chest height, crisp sharp focus on her from head to feet, fine detail in the silk and the wet stone, natural colour grading.
4.note: 背對鏡頭。prompt 寫 "standing almost square to the camera and turned no more than fifteen degrees"，模型仍轉成背面，mediapipe 偵測不到臉。不能進訓練集。畫面本身漂亮，勉強可當背影素材。

5.pillar: 私下 / 老宅（古典舞底子）
5.prompt:
A photograph of <<<a0e68491-43ac-40c8-99d5-fec60596ac50>>>, a 23-year-old Chinese woman in Suzhou, seen from head to below the knee, her body turned about fifty-five degrees away from the camera with her head turned back toward the lens.

Her build: narrow shoulders and a full rounded bust that reads clearly against how slight the rest of her is. Visible collarbone, slim upper arms. Her waist is narrow, and the contrast between that small waist and the fuller chest is part of her shape. Her lower abdomen is flat and her hips are about as wide as her shoulders. Her legs are long and straight. She is 165cm and slight. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden or wheat-coloured), with visible skin pores, subtle natural skin texture, a slight oil sheen on the T-zone and unretouched skin detail.

Her black hair is pulled into a tight high dancer's bun, nothing falling forward, her forehead, eyebrows, cheekbones and jawline all fully exposed.

She wears a fitted slate-grey long-sleeved practice top tucked into wide soft black practice trousers tied at the waist, the top close enough to the body to read her ribcage and waist, bare feet on the stone.

She stands in the covered wooden walkway around the open courtyard well of the old house, mid-way through practising. A pair of practice shoes sits kicked off against a pillar, a water bottle and a folded towel on the step, a phone propped against the bottle playing music, and a broom leaning in the corner. The stone floor of the courtyard has just been rinsed and is still wet.

A hard shaft of late-morning sun drops straight down into the open courtyard well from above and lands on the wet stone a metre in front of her. That wet grey stone kicks a cool grey light back up onto her legs and the underside of her jaw, and the whitewashed wall of the walkway returns a soft neutral fill onto her back. Warm direct sun fills the courtyard shaft while she stands in cool open-shade skylight under the eaves, two clearly different colour temperatures in one frame. Exposure is set for her in the shade, so the sunlit patch of courtyard floor clips to white. The carved wooden pillar and the overhanging eaves cut the light into a hard-edged shaft.

She has stopped mid-phrase and is looking back at the camera, breathing, a trace of effort still in her face, mouth slightly open.

The only person anywhere in this photograph is her — no one else in the room, no one in any doorway, no figure in any mirror or window reflection, no portrait or photograph of a person on any wall or screen. Every visible hand connects to one of her own arms.

Shot on a rear phone camera from about three metres away, crisp sharp focus on her, fine detail in the knit and the wet stone, natural colour grading, subtle motion blur at the loose end of her sleeve.
5.note: 同樣背對鏡頭，臉只露極小側面，mediapipe 偵測不到。不能進訓練集。

_meta.design_basis: 覆核 R3 Q-13 的 5 張配額 + SEXY_SCENE_LIBRARY 反 AI 感五項 + 五段式光線規格
_meta.single_subject: 訓練集例外：全部選她本來就合理獨處的場景（老宅、自家旗袍店、清晨園林、天井），不需要假造空景公共場所
_meta.finding_framing: 「turned no more than fifteen degrees」對 seedream_v4_5 無效——兩張全身圖都被轉成背面。推測是全身站姿構圖的先驗把人物轉開。下一輪要改成正面的正向敘述（她的臉與身體正面朝向鏡頭），而不是用角度上限這種否定式限制。這與本專案既有發現一致：結構性否定詞是無效的。
_meta.outcome: 5 張裡 3 張可用（#1 #2 #3），2 張因背對鏡頭作廢。
